hermes-legal

Frontend placeholder for the Tauri 2 shell. The shell starts the Python sidecar (legal serve, bound to 127.0.0.1:8770 only) and loads the local dashboard the sidecar serves. This static page is only what you see before the sidecar answers, or if it failed to start.

The Hermes plugin and the local dashboard remain fully usable without this shell. See docs/desktop.md for the decision and desktop/packaging.md for how installers are built and signed.
